title: Kill gate of Stage 5 (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/mutation.json, not committed)
description: Protocol §5, Stage 5 step 3: gate of the suite, not of the candidate. The mutants come from the changed lines (operation: mutate of the engine); each one is judged with the set T (the candidate's changed tests + the run's overlay) on the candidate with the mutated file on top, against a clean run of T on the candidate. kill_rate = killed / (killed + survived). PASS only if kill_rate >= threshold and nothing was left unrun or ungenerated (not_run, not_generated): what was not measured does not count as killed.

round.description: Saboteur rounds done in Stage 5 when it was written.

tests.description: Test files of T against which each mutant was judged. Empty: nothing can kill a mutant and all of them survive without running anything (running the command without files would run the full suite).

red_on_candidate.description: Tests of T red in the candidate without mutating: they cannot kill anyone. If there is any, the stage stops at INCONCLUSIVE: a red test would kill everything and fake kill_rate 1.

status.description: killed: a test green in the clean run turned red. survived: all stay green. inconclusive: the run could not be judged (no JUnit, no testcases, red without an identifiable test, timeout); it does not enter kill_rate. not_run: not run (max_mutants cap, interrupted run).

not_generated.description: What the engine did not turn into mutants (file that does not parse, max_mutants cap of the engine). Prevents PASS.

unsupported.description: Changed files in scope that no engine mutates, with the reason. The PASS gate reads unsupported_files, which lists the same files without reasons: any of them blocks PASS.

unsupported_files.description: Changed files in scope that no engine mutated (no engine, or its engine has no operation: mutate). Unlike unsupported, they block PASS: a file nobody mutated is not measured.

pruned_equivalent.description: Equivalent mutants that the engine pruned (conservative AST: logging, assert, branch with constant condition) in the changed lines, with the reason. They are not mutants: they do not enter mutants, kill_rate, nor block PASS. Empty if nothing was pruned.

kill_rate.description: null if no mutant ended up killed or survived.
